title: Stupefied Mobs
description: A mod that lets you disable mob AI by using a nametag
body:
This mod lets you **reduce lag** by **disabling mob AI** with a **nametag** item.
You can change which names have their AI disabled using the **external config**.

### Config
- **disabledNames**: a list of **mob names** that will have their AI disabled (supports wildcard character *)
- **disableOnSpawn**: will disable AI when the mob is **loaded**, not only just when it's renamed (recommended and default: true)
- **logActions**: displays actions in the console (for developers)

### Planned additions
- Having a separate way to disable **villager activities** while keeping trading intact
- Being able to **stupefy mob spawners** for a less load-heavy mob farm
